mapper.insert: INSERT INTO api_table (id, api_id, database_name, table_name, alias, join_type, join_condition) VALUES (#{id}, #{apiId}, #{databaseName}, #{tableName}, #{alias}, #{joinType}, #{joinCondition})
mapper.update: UPDATE api_table SET api_id = #{apiId}, database_name = #{databaseName}, table_name = #{tableName}, alias = #{alias}, join_type = #{joinType}, join_condition = #{joinCondition} WHERE id = #{id}
